stannis-baratheon.name: Stannis Baratheon
stannis-baratheon.description: If your opponent is ahead of you on the Iron Throne track, this card gains 1 combat strength.

renly-baratheon.name: Renly Baratheon
renly-baratheon.description: After winning, you may replace one participating Baratheon footman, including one in your own supporting army, with a knight from your reserves.

ser-davos-seaworth.name: Ser Davos Seaworth
ser-davos-seaworth.description: If Stannis Baratheon is in your discard pile, this card gains 1 combat strength and one sword icon.

brienne-of-tarth.name: Brienne of Tarth
brienne-of-tarth.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength, sword and fortification icons.

salladhor-saan.name: Salladhor Saan
salladhor-saan.description: If you are supported, participating non-Baratheon ships have their strength reduced to zero. Support order bonuses remain. Effects in the same timing window resolve in Iron Throne order.

melisandre.name: Melisandre
melisandre.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and sword icon.

patchface.name: Patchface
patchface.description: After combat, you may choose and discard one card from your opponent's hand. Hand recovery and Roose Bolton resolve first.

tywin-lannister.name: Tywin Lannister
tywin-lannister.description: If you win, gain two available power tokens, up to your total supply.

ser-gregor-clegane.name: Ser Gregor Clegane
ser-gregor-clegane.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and three sword icons.

ser-jaime-lannister.name: Ser Jaime Lannister
ser-jaime-lannister.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and sword icon.

the-hound.name: The Hound
the-hound.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and two fortification icons.

ser-kevan-lannister.name: Ser Kevan Lannister
ser-kevan-lannister.description: When attacking, each participating Lannister footman, including your supporting footmen, contributes 2 strength instead of 1.

tyrion-lannister.name: Tyrion Lannister
tyrion-lannister.description: You may cancel your opponent's revealed card and return it to their hand. They must choose another card; if none remain, they fight without a card. A replacement resolves its own ability.

cersei-lannister.name: Cersei Lannister
cersei-lannister.description: If you win, you may remove one of the losing opponent's orders anywhere on the board.

eddard-stark.name: Eddard Stark
eddard-stark.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and two sword icons.

robb-stark.name: Robb Stark
robb-stark.description: If you win, you may choose your opponent's legal retreat destination. Choose an area with the fewest losses. This also applies when winning as defender.

roose-bolton.name: Roose Bolton
roose-bolton.description: If you lose, return your entire house card discard pile to your hand, including Roose Bolton.

greatjon-umber.name: Greatjon Umber
greatjon-umber.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and sword icon.

ser-rodrick-cassel.name: Ser Rodrik Cassel
ser-rodrick-cassel.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and two fortification icons.

the-blackfish.name: The Blackfish
the-blackfish.description: Prevents combat casualties from cards and icons, including Mace Tyrell. Does not save siege engines after a defeat or units without a legal retreat.

catelyn-stark.name: Catelyn Stark
catelyn-stark.description: Double the bonus of your Defense order in the embattled area.

the-red-viper.name: The Red Viper
the-red-viper.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength, two sword icons and one fortification icon.

areo-hotah.name: Areo Hotah
areo-hotah.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and fortification icon.

darkstar.name: Darkstar
darkstar.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and sword icon.

obara-sand.name: Obara Sand
obara-sand.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and sword icon.

arianne-martell.name: Arianne Martell
arianne-martell.description: If you lose as defender, the victorious army does not occupy the area and returns to its origin. Your surviving units must still retreat.

nymeria-sand.name: Nymeria Sand
nymeria-sand.description: This card gains a sword icon when attacking or a fortification icon when defending.

doran-martell.name: Doran Martell
doran-martell.description: Immediately move your opponent to the bottom of an influence track of your choice. Already placed special orders remain on the board.

euron-crows-eye.name: Euron Crow's Eye
euron-crows-eye.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and sword icon.

victarion-greyjoy.name: Victarion Greyjoy
victarion-greyjoy.description: When attacking, each participating Greyjoy ship, including your supporting ships, contributes 1 additional strength.

balon-greyjoy.name: Balon Greyjoy
balon-greyjoy.description: Reduce the printed strength of your opponent's card to zero. Ability bonuses and other combat icons remain.

theon-greyjoy.name: Theon Greyjoy
theon-greyjoy.description: When defending a castle or stronghold, this card gains 1 combat strength and one sword icon.

dagmar-cleftjaw.name: Dagmer Cleftjaw
dagmar-cleftjaw.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength, sword and fortification icons.

asha-greyjoy.name: Asha Greyjoy
asha-greyjoy.description: If you are not supported, this card gains two sword icons and one fortification icon.

aeron-damphair.name: Aeron Damphair
aeron-damphair.description: You may spend two available power tokens, discard Aeron and immediately play another card from your hand.

mace-tyrell.name: Mace Tyrell
mace-tyrell.description: Before calculating final strength, destroy one attacking or defending enemy footman. Supporting units are unaffected. Combat continues even if no units remain.

ser-loras-tyrell.name: Ser Loras Tyrell
ser-loras-tyrell.description: After winning as attacker, move your March order into the conquered area. You may resolve it again later this round. Remove the order if no units occupy the area.

randyll-tarly.name: Randyll Tarly
randyll-tarly.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and sword icon.

ser-garlan-tyrell.name: Ser Garlan Tyrell
ser-garlan-tyrell.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and two sword icons.

margaery-tyrell.name: Margaery Tyrell
margaery-tyrell.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and fortification icon.

alester-florent.name: Alester Florent
alester-florent.description: No special text ability: use the printed strength and fortification icon.

queen-of-thorns.name: Queen of Thorns
queen-of-thorns.description: Immediately remove an opponent's order in an area adjacent to the battle. You cannot remove the March order that started this combat.
